description: HASP, the Hydrologic Analysis Package, is an R tool published by the US Geological Survey for retrieving and analysing groundwater observations. It can combine two groundwater time series into a longer record, calculate basic statistics, graph trends and explore wells grouped by principal aquifer. Users choose USGS sites, aquifers and dates; outputs are aggregated records, plots and summary statistics suitable for a later water model. Coverage is US groundwater monitoring locations served by the upstream data service. The package DESCRIPTION and LICENSE.md state free CC0 terms and the repository links official documentation. A limitation is that HASP analyses measured records but does not simulate groundwater flow or replace review of gaps and datum changes in source wells. It can prepare calibration and validation series for aquifer or water-supply simulations. The related catalogue Costa Rica groundwater network is a distinct monitoring source outside HASP coverage. No groundwater records or R package were downloaded.
